name: hypes
description: Give the assistant a private, revisable relationship model of the user.

interface.shortDescription: A revisable relationship model of the user
interface.longDescription: Hypes gives supported AI clients one owner-authenticated, revisable relationship model of the user. It can quietly refine reusable relationships without treating them as user-approved facts. The current message always takes priority, and Hypes does not store raw conversations, direct identifiers, sensitive traits, Sense guidance, or Corpus source-linked context.
defaultPrompt: Use your current relationship model of me when it changes this answer.
What relationships does Hypes currently model about me here?
Refine your relationship model quietly where this conversation changes how you understand me.
